errors.evidence: The description states the y-axis range is 0 to 100, but the data for 2021 clearly extends beyond the 100 mark to a value of approximately 112. The description incorrectly limits the data range to the labeled ticks.
The blue bar for the year 2013 has a value of approximately 2, not 1.
The orange bar for the year 2012 has a value of approximately 2, not 1.
The description of the range for orange bars stops at the value for 2020, but fails to mention that the series continues and reaches its peak value of approximately 47 in 2021.

errors.text_span: there is no visual emphasis on particular bars
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bars for the year 2022 are rendered in a much lighter, faded color than the bars for all other years, which is a clear form of visual differentiation or de-emphasis.

errors.text_span: the shift in data collection practices over time
errors.evidence: This phrase is an interpretation of what the data implies about real-world practices, rather than a direct description of the visual information presented in the chart, which is the number of datasets.
